title: Chapter 619 - 619 Settling It Once And For All; Breaking The Sea And Slaying The Heavens!

Chapter 619 - 619 Settling It Once And For All; Breaking The Sea And Slaying The Heavens!

Chapter 619 - 619 Settling It Once and For All; Breaking the Sea and Slaying the Heavens!

619 Settling It Once and For All; Breaking the Sea and Slaying the Heavens!

Silence….

The entire place was silent again.

Everyone heard it. It was a level-seven Sea Python.

Almost all of them had fought with wild beasts and monsters before, so they knew very well how powerful and terrifying a level-seven monster was.

In the end, it was killed in the blink of an eye?

Instantly, everyone had a deeper understanding of Lin Fan’s strength.

If it were in the past, everyone would definitely be envious of 500 Constitution points. They might even have some thoughts about the points.

Now, no one had such thoughts.

What happened to Govindo and the Sea Python was the best example.

However, Lin Fan did not touch the ball of light. Instead, he said, “Heavenly Hound, go and use these 500 Constitution points.”

The Heavenly Hound stepped forward and placed its paw on the ball of light.

Seeing this…

Everyone was jealous.

500 Constitution points were given to a dog?

Why not give the points to them?

Mordmohan could not help but say, “…A dog? Wouldn’t it be too wasteful? Why didn’t he use the points himself?”

Abraham said, “This bit of Constitution points probably won’t be of much use to Lin Fan. In the past, Lin Fan had given the Heavenly Hound Constitution points, spiritual energy points, and even some special abilities.”

When Modmohan heard this, her mouth was wide open, and her beautiful face was filled with disbelief.

Constitution and spiritual energy points were a little easier to accept.

However, special abilities… Those were equivalent to a superpower or a technique!

Lin Fan directly gave them to a dog?

…

While everyone was shocked and sighing, the blood of the Sea Python had already begun to spread.

At this moment, the surface of the flowing sea suddenly seemed to boil as it kept bubbling.

However…

Everyone’s attention was focused on Lin Fan. No one noticed this change.

In the next moment…

A giant red crab suddenly popped its head out and raised a towering wave.

It opened its ferocious mouth and bit the body of the python.

No!

It was not just a red crab.

There were four crimson giant crabs!

The four red crabs divided the body of the giant python and ate it!

They were attracted by the smell of blood.

However, it was obvious that they were not the only ones who liked the smell of blood.

Soon, three giant white sharks followed suit.

Then, there were three giant golden prawns.

Then, there were two giant dragons with crowns on their heads…

Just the number of monsters that had surfaced on the surface of the sea alone exceeded ten!

Moreover, each monster was extremely huge and exuded an extremely terrifying aura.

In a short while, the body of the giant python, which was several meters thick and dozens of meters long, was eaten clean.

However, these monsters did not disperse. Instead, they focused their scarlet eyes on the heroes of the various countries and slowly approached the rock island.

Seeing this…

The faces of the heroes from all over the world turned slightly pale.

Any one of these monsters was tough to fight against.

Now, more than ten of them had appeared!

What should they do?

It was a disaster!

A terrifying disaster!

Then, they looked up at Lin Fan.

At this moment, Lin Fan was probably the only one who could resolve this crisis.

Lin Fan did not disappoint them either.

Lin Fan waved his sword and shot out sharp sword lights.

The red giant crab closest to the front was cut in half, and blood flowed out.

Next, it was the other three red crabs beside it.

Then, the three giant white sharks were dealt with.

After that, it was the three giant golden prawns.

Finally, it was the two giant dragons with crowns on their heads…

Every sword strike took the life of a beast or monster without exception.

It was as easy as cutting tofu.

Soon, the blue sea turned dark red.

At this moment, an emotionless voice sounded.

[The first to kill a level-seven Red Crab. You’ve obtained a level-seven treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Red Crab. 50 types of extinct creatures in Hua Nation have resurrected.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Giant White Shark. You’ve obtained a level-seven treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Giant White Shark. Air quality in Hua Nation has increased by 10%.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Golden-Armored Giant Shrimp. You’ve obtained a level-seven treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Golden-Armored Giant Shrimp. Hua Nation’s energy has increased by 10%.]

[The first to kill a level-eight One-Horned Dragon. You’ve obtained a level-eight treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-eight One-Horned Dragon. The number of species in Hua Nation’s oceans has increased by 20%.]

…

After a series of sounds, several treasure chests appeared in front of Lin Fan.

However, he did not open them directly.

Instead, he looked ahead with a pair of indifferent eyes.

That was because rolling waves had appeared in the distance.

Many huge monsters were rushing over.

Vaguely, Lin Fan could see huge turtles, ferocious sharks, and terrifying seals…

These monsters were surrounded by a terrifying aura, which stirred up towering waves and formed a strong wind. It blew everyone’s clothes and sent rocks flying.

Lin Fan said calmly, “Are you done? Then let’s settle it all at once!”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan raised the Star Meteorite Sword in his hand.

A vast sword energy soared into the sky, as if it had pierced through the sky. It formed a huge hole.

Then, Lin Fan opened his mouth and spat out a single word.

“Slash!”

[Skill: Sword 13!]

In an instant, the entire world seemed to be enveloped in a white haze.

The violent wind forced everyone to cover their eyes with their hands.

After a long time, the wind gradually subsided, and everyone slowly removed their hands.

In the next moment…

Everyone’s eyes widened in shock.

That was because a bottomless ravine had appeared in the middle of the boundless sea, completely blocking the convergence of the seawater on both sides.

One sword cut through the sea!

No!

Not only did it cut off the sea…

In the cloudless sky, a symmetrical black void also appeared!

Lin Fan’s one sword broke the sea and slashed the sky!

It was simply terrifying!

At this moment, a series of emotionless voices rang out.

[The first to kill a level-eight Dragon Snapping Turtle. You’ve obtained a level-eight treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-eight Dragon Snapping Turtle. Hua Nation’s marine ecosystem has been enhanced by 10%.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Golden Tiger Shark. You’ve obtained a level-seven treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Golden Tiger Shark. The number of endangered animals in Hua Nation has increased by 10%.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Jadehorn Snake Fish. You’ve obtained a level-seven treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-seven Jadehorn Snake Fish. Hua citizens’ lifespan has increased by one year.]

…

Soon, nearly 30 chests appeared in front of Lin Fan!

In other words, that sword had killed nearly 30 types of beasts and monsters!

As for the exact number of monsters killed, it was completely unknown.
